turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, I'm Smita. I'm getting possession of my flat in Undri in about six weeks. 2BHK, 875 sq ft. I want to start the design right away.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Six weeks is just enough lead time to get the design finalised before execution begins. What are you planning?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Full home — kitchen, wardrobes, living room. The full package.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good scope. Are you the owner?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes — my husband and I. He said to go ahead and book the consultation.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can we see the site in its current state, or do you need to wait for possession?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We can go now — the builder will let us in.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Even better. Let me get a designer's availability.

facts.name: Smita
facts.timeline_raw: Possession in about six weeks; start design now
facts.decision_maker_note: Husband said to go ahead and book
facts.summary: New 2BHK in Undri, possession in six weeks, full package, wants design to start now.
